{{EditSection|Badges/Map}} '''Map Badges''' were awarded to players who beat specific maps. You could get these badges on any mode after you triumph a map. Each map has varying levels of difficulty so some badges are more common than others. Your beaten maps would then appear in the ''Scores'' tab. After the Overhaul Update, all '''Map Badges''' were disabled.
